steps.name: A Voice on the Broadcast
steps.text: Our champion, having appeared out of nowhere, has put a stop to the battle with a thunderous momentum!

steps.name: A Voice on the Broadcast
steps.text: Last night's match was cut short when Nightmare Knight's Arts were ruled a violation, and the one who stopped things from getting even further out of hand was the hero, the Blood Knight!

steps.name: A Voice on the Broadcast
steps.text: The match between the Radiant Knight and Nightmare Knight ended in a tie, and Nightmare will be facing the Blood Knight, whose opponent has dropped out, in his next round—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: A tie...? Nightmare broke the rules. Shouldn't they have promoted the Radiant Knight to the next round?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: They don't want to let an Infected to just move up the ranks like that, of course.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Where's Szewczyk?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: He's with his family. Give him some time.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: To be honest... I didn't really care much about him to begin with.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We can tell.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: True enough. Were you trying to hide it?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: He's still alive, real flesh and blood, right?

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: The city makes us forget it a lot... but we're all alive.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: We should have our own choices, our own lives... instead of drifting about in the endlessly beating waves, never to find out who we really are.

steps.name: A Voice on the Broadcast
steps.text: The battle of a lifetime between the Blood Knight and Nightmare Knight will begin tomorrow evening!

steps.name: A Voice on the Broadcast
steps.text: Be sure to tune into the Night of Knights channel tomorrow at 8 o'clock for the best competition experience!

steps.name: 'Justice Knight'
steps.text: (Loud beeping noises)

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Oh... Justice! You're okay!

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona! You can't get up yet.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Come, I'll help you.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Heh... Thanks, Ashley.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: I thought I had exclusive rights to the nickname Ashley?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Haha, let me borrow it for a while.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: You're gonna have to pay for using my trademark.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Iwona, that day...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Yeah, I saw the Blood Knight's silhouette.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: There were traces of blood Arts...

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: It's... a really awful kind of Arts. As things are, just casting normal Arts is enough to make me ache. I can't imagine how much pain the Blood Knight has to bear, controlling Arts like that.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Blood Knight... He's strong.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: Everybody knows.

steps.name: Sona
steps.text: It's thanks to the Blood Knight that the Infected won the right to fight in the Major.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: We became the K.G.C.C.'s playthings... We lost our dignity and freedom... but we're still alive.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: It's only by staying alive that we have the chance to run.

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: Between the Radiant Knight and the Blood Knight, who do you support, girls?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: The Blood Knight. No doubt about it. He's the one who opened up the future for us Infected.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But what we need is an unflagging fight instead of the status quo... so I choose the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And you?

steps.name: Justyna
steps.text: I pick Sona.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You can do that?!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You called...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: The Board has made their decision... Area 0 will be wiped clean.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Our current strategy with the Infected is a mistake.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: A mistake, huh...?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Moreover, Rhodes Island's leader has been digging too deep into the Area 0 affair. This is a lapse on the Armorless Union's part.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Several executive directors are strongly demanding the Armorless Union eradicate this threat. Do not let Rhodes Island's medical team leave Kazimierz alive.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Any issues?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: None... but this is only an order from 'several executive directors' and not the whole Board. Right?

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: That is not for you to question. We have authority over your command.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Point of order, it's Mr. Malkiewicz over there who has authority over me.

steps.name: Spokesman McKee
steps.text: Malkiewicz... You know what to do.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you hurt?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Yeah... Probably when I blocked his strike.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I couldn't feel a thing at the time... but it might have bruised a bone or two.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hold still. Let me see...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You need a doctor. This will affect your performance.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Maybe put some ice on it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Can't we heal this with Arts?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That will alleviate the pain and help the wound heal, but if she's got any broken bones, she could end up worse in the future if we don't take proper care of them.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: What do we do? You're up against the Wind Knight the next match... That's a strong opponent. If you have to fight this hurt...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Don't worry so much.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: How am I supposed to not worry?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: It's just a minor injury. I'm more than used to this.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You call this... minor...?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret... You've worked so hard, and you've gotten so strong... What is it all for?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: To become a champion?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: 'You cannot surmount the rulesetters within their own rules.' Isn't that what Uncle said?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Mhm...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But that's just because Młynar—

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No, I get it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: He's right.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But it's not the rulesetters that we need to defeat.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: We need to break free of the rules. We need to teach those who have been tamed to rise up, help those who have fallen to regain the light.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Uncle Młynar... He doesn't believe that there are still those who would follow a lighthouse's beam and charge into the storm.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: But I don't agree with him.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: If we can dispel this darkness, the people will push forward.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You need to listen to the doctor and rest up for a few days.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Your next match is against the Wind Knight, right? If you don't recover by then, it won't go well for you.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Don't end up like me...

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: I knew my arm was no good, but I pushed myself even further. This is what I got.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Right. You needn't worry about me.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Margaret... Look! Ta-dah!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: The new gauntlet?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Already...? That's amazing. I thought it'd take you until tomorrow.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It probably would've taken me another two or three days if I was working by myself.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: We didn't adjust your gauntlet around your new weapon last time, not that we'd know where to start.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: But that taught us a lesson, and it really got Maria working.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Maria... I know some excellent craftsmen. Perhaps I should introduce them to you.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Really?! Where are they from?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: All over. Ursus, Leithanien, Higashi, Laterano... you name it.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Whoa... That's like a whole guild of master craftsmen... Hm? Why would a pharma company need so many craftsmen, though?

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You'll just have to find out for yourself.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: This reminds me... there was this one year when Uncle Młynar bought you a small drone for your birthday.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: You had the thing torn apart that afternoon.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... I put it back together after that, though.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: I was shocked, you know. It might not have flown again after she put it back together, but I never expected the kid to have such amazing talent—

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: —I half expected Maria to become a knight back then, though. Otherwise, I'd have entrusted her with my workshop.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You better get on that, Kowal. Who knows when you'll kick the bucket?

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Huh? Cursing me now, are you?!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Do you want to pursue your interests, Maria?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Erm... I don't know yet.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hah, Maria's still young.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I just know that... it's been a very long time since we talked like this...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Oh! I forgot to bring the restoration gel!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: We still have to try out the new gauntlet... The match is coming up soon, isn't it? I'll head back to the workshop now!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Margaret... Those are some serious injuries...)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Hm? What's that noise?
The Nightzmora drags his weapon across the floor, sending tiny sparks everywhere.
Enraged, he mutters to himself. He has made his way here following only the smell of the light.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —Aaah?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Ngh...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You... You are not her... Right, you are her sister.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Where is she?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: —! You want Margaret! Why?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Our battle has not yet ended.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: But the match's over!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The match...?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: My Khaganquest's purpose is not a mere match in a competition.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight is an essential part of this path... Our holy battle should not have been interrupted!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Then you just have to defeat the Blood Knight and fight my sister the next round—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Competitions... The Major... They are all for show.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You heard the rules, you heard the crowd! Couldn't you feel how laughable and blasphemous it all was?!
Is this the Major? What is it you won? What did you get from all this?
Glory, wealth, your family's honor, but what is it you're missing...? Hm, what is it you're missing?
And without much time to think about it, as if in pure response to the cheering all around her, Maria holds her sword up high.
Only the pain, sharp, radiating from her hand, overcomes the applause.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Do not take me for a jester entertaining the masses!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I am a descendant of the Kheshig. I must complete my Khaganquest!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Stand aside, I have no interest in frail children! The only business I have is for the Radiant Knight—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I won't let you pass.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You...?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You are nothing but an affinity of the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: A... An affinity?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Your dream is taken from another. Your conviction is borrowed.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You use your young age as an excuse for your confusion... but what point is there?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The world can laugh at the Radiant Knight's stubbornness, but no one may refute the strength in her actions.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Yet you... you are not even a knight.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Now stand aside, lest my blade slice your throat open.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I won't let you see my sister.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Is she hiding? No... With her brilliant light, the Radiant Knight is above that...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Then... is she injured?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You mean to tell me I injured her in our fight, and I must wait until she recovers before our next match?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Shameless!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Nngh––!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (So heavy—That's heavier than Tytus's lance strikes!)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Haahh... haaahh...

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Why am I...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Look at you... already drowned in fear...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You cannot wield your weapon in front of me. If we had met on the battlefield, you would already be dead.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: This... has nothing to do with knights.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I just want... to protect... my sister—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: The Radiant Knight is not for you to protect, you ignorant pegasus...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Guh!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This arrow... A far cry from that blue archer.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Step away from the child, Nightzmora.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Will you stand in my way too?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Maria! Quick, stand up! Come over here!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: R-Right!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Are you nuts?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: This is not the first time you asked me this question.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I thought... at least you would...

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You have nowhere to go, kid.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Tell me, where is your Khagan?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Where is the Kheshig's banner? Where are their tents?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: It's been a thousand years... Why live in that past? Why chase that tradition?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What can all that bring you, kid?
Tola.
Your name means 'grasslands.'
You must take pride in your bloodline.
Whensoever and wheresoever you stand, you must take pride in yourself.
Tola.
You must live as a normal Kuranta. This is very simple.
Study, grow up, learn a trade, and marry a beautiful wife.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Batbayar, I made up my mind when my mother died to the fangs of a wild beast.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: It was this nightmare of mine... that made me a Nightzmora.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What kind of nonsense are you on about—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: I have struggled for years... in this country of knights.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Yet, in the end, I was guided to this path to fulfill my last ideals.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Hold on... hold on.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: You can't seriously mean... your journey was all for—

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Speak no more.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You are old and frail, but it does not change the fact you once stood on the battlefields. If you insist on standing in my way...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Then I shall trample upon you and destroy one of my last remaining blood kin with my own hands.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Come. I shall charge you.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Master Vogelweide—Get out of there!

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Maria, are you okay?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I-I'm fine.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: We can't let this lunatic find Margaret... Or else—!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You would stand in my way... So you will kill me?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: Do knights of Kazimierz truly know what it means to fight to the death?

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: No, you cannot possibly. Batbayar, you are old. And you, naive pegasus, you know nothing of the cruelty of the world.

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You would interfere in my fight with her. You are sullying both our names and honor.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Honor doesn't matter at all!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: —Then what does your sister fight for?!

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You dare spout such blasphemy?! You dare claim the Radiant Knight vies for the Major's title not to regain her glory?!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: *Whimpers*...

steps.name: Nightmare Knight
steps.text: You heretic! Raise your weapon! You will pay the price!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I... still won't let you pass!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ever!
